verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that gives an "instant overview of your company's status in each state", where you can click a state to see requirements and upcoming deadlines (docs-6, docs-8). It also says Firstbase tracks all compliance deadlines and handles annual and franchise-tax filings (docs-7), across registered-agent and foreign-qualification coverage in all 50 states (supp-1). However, the evidence describes a single company's per-state view, not one dashboard spanning every entity a legal-ops lead manages. Missing for 10: multi-entity portfolio view, explicit good-standing status indicators, any screenshots or detail of the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.
